title: Galen University Anthropology Club promotes Belize’s Archaeological heritage on World Archaeology Day
description: By Zoila Palma: Galen University’s Anthropology Club participated in World Archaeology Day celebrations by hosting an educational outreach booth at Cahal Pech in San Ignacio, Cayo. title: Rembrandt Turned Ancient Myths Into 'Supremely Human' Works of Art. An Upcoming Exhibition Traces the Inspiration He Took From Antiquity
description: "Rembrandt and the Ancients" at the Metropolitan Museum of Art will unpack an "underexplored but vital" part of the Dutch master's career, putting his paintings and drawings in conversation with the antecedents that inspired them

title: 6-year-old Eagle boy discovers rare fossil at Schramm Park in Gretna
description: The fossil is of an ancient, jelly-fish-like marine animal called a conulariid, the Nebraska Game and Parks Commission said. Conulariids lived 200 million-500 million years ago.
